We are looking for an organized Office Manager to keep our dental practice running smoothly.

Responsibilities

  • Manage front desk operations, scheduling and patient check-in
  • Process payroll and accounts payable using QuickBooks
  • Coordinate with insurance companies on claims and billing
  • Supervise front office staff

Requirements

  • High school diploma or GED required; Associate degree preferred
  • 3+ years of office management experience
  • Experience with QuickBooks and Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)
  • Experience supervising staff
  • Dental or medical office experience preferred
  • Valid driver's license
